# IdeaStress

> Open-source, deterministic Business-as-Code feasibility, reverse unit-economics solver, 1,000-run Monte Carlo simulator, real Google Ads CPC falsifier, and 10-in-1 free startup calculator suite for founders and AI coding agents (MCP & CLI).

## Free No-Signup Calculators

- [Home & Monte Carlo Solver](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/): Stress-test your startup or SaaS idea with deterministic math, 1,000-run Monte Carlo survival probability, US Stripe & tax presets, and 2026 industry base rates.
- [Reverse CAC Solver](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/reverse-cac-calculator/): Calculate the exact maximum CAC, minimum price floor, and 12-month Monte Carlo survival probability your startup cash budget can afford.
- [Break-Even](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/break-even-calculator/): Compute exact monthly break-even units, revenue, and net contribution margin after US Stripe or Merchant-of-Record processing fees.
- [SaaS LTV / CAC](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/saas-ltv-cac-calculator/): Calculate gross-margin-adjusted SaaS LTV, LTV:CAC ratio, and CAC payback months calibrated against 2026 ChartMogul & Benchmarkit medians.
- [E-Commerce ROAS](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/ecommerce-roas-calculator/): Calculate exact Break-Even ROAS, max profitable CPA, and first-order net profit after COGS, shipping, and Stripe US card fees.
- [Startup Runway](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/startup-runway-calculator/): Stress-test your startup cash runway under a -30% revenue drop and +20% expense overrun before hiring or scaling paid ads.
- [AI Token Margin](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/ai-token-margin-calculator/): Calculate real AI SaaS gross margin after LLM token COGS and Stripe US fees, and find the exact daily request ceiling where power users turn unprofitable.
- [Geo-Arbitrage CPC](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/geo-arbitrage-cpc-scanner/): Compare Google Ads CPC and localized survival ceilings across US, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Malaysia to spot blue-ocean markets.
- [Quit-Job MRR](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/quit-job-mrr-calculator/): Calculate exact MRR and paying customers needed to replace your salary after US taxes, operating costs, and Stripe vs Paddle/Lemon Squeezy fees.
- [Freemium Drag](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/freemium-economics-calculator/): Stress-test whether free-tier hosting and AI token costs destroy your SaaS margins, and solve your exact minimum free-to-paid conversion rate.
- [Meta/TikTok CPM](https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/meta-tiktok-cpm-calculator/): Convert Meta and TikTok paid social CPM, CTR, and landing page conversion rate into exact CPA, Break-Even ROAS, and first-order profit.

## Key 2025-2026 Cited Industry Base Rates Used by IdeaStress
- SaaS Monthly Churn: 6.2% median (ARPA < $25), 2.6% median (ARPA > $1,000) — ChartMogul (Nov 2026): https://chartmogul.com/benchmarks/
- Private SaaS Benchmarks: 80% software gross margin median, 16-month CAC payback, 4.1x LTV:CAC — Benchmarkit / SubscriptionPlaybook (2026): https://www.subscriptionplaybook.com/benchmarks/
- Indie SaaS Revenue Base Rate: $145 median MRR across 3,700+ startups (23.6% > $1K MRR, 6.1% > $10K MRR) — TrustMRR / BigIdeasDB (Sep 2026): https://bigideasdb.com/dimeadozen-alternative
- US Payment Fees: Stripe US domestic cards 2.9% + $0.30 (https://stripe.com/pricing); Merchant of Record (Paddle/Lemon Squeezy) 5% + $0.50
- E-Commerce Benchmarks: 1.4% Shopify median CVR (top 20% > 2.7%, Littledata Nov 2026); $53–$91 blended ecommerce CAC (First Page Sage 2026)

## Open-Source CLI & MCP Server (12 Tools)
- Install: `pip install ideastress`
- Start MCP Server (Claude Code / Cursor / Codex): `ideastress mcp`
- Core MCP tools: `precode_gate_check`, `solve_unit_frontiers`, `auto_fix_unit_economics`, `scan_repo_api_costs`, `falsify_paid_channel`, `scan_geo_arbitrage`, `check_scope_creep_finops`, `stress_test_ai_margin`, `generate_kill_test_kit`, `scan_competitor_complaints`, `diff_assumption_ledger`, `get_industry_base_rates`.

# Detailed Formulas, Worked Examples & FAQs

## Reverse Unit-Economics Survival Frontier & Monte Carlo Solver
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/

### Exact Formula
```text
Net_Unit_Contrib = Unit_Price × (1 − Refund_Rate) − Variable_Cost − Payment_Fee
Max_Viable_CAC = GoalSeek(CAC : min_{m=1..12} Ending_Cash(m) ≥ 0)
Implied_Paid_CAC = Google_Ads_CPC / Landing_Page_CVR
```

### Worked Example
For a $49/mo SaaS with $6 variable cost, Stripe US fee ($1.72), $900 fixed costs, 5% monthly churn, 14 new customers/mo, and $12,000 starting cash, net unit contribution is ~$40.30. Over 12 months, the business can survive up to ~$210 CAC; however, if US Google Ads CPC is $8.90 at 2.5% conversion, implied paid CAC is $356 — triggering CHANNEL_IMPOSSIBLE before spending $1 on ads.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: What is a Reverse Unit-Economics Survival Frontier?**
  A: Instead of guessing 3-year revenue, a reverse solver works backward from your cash budget, price, and fixed costs to compute the exact maximum CAC, minimum price floor, and maximum churn your business can survive over 12 months.
- **Q: How does the 1,000-run Monte Carlo simulation work?**
  A: It runs 1,000 reproducible seeded paths perturbing monthly acquisition volume, upward-skewed CAC overruns, variable cost drift, and a realistic Month 1–2 SaaS onboarding churn spike to output survival probability and P10/P50/P90 cash percentiles.
- **Q: Why did my profitable SaaS get a CHANNEL_IMPOSSIBLE warning?**
  A: Even when unit margins are strong, crowded Google Ads categories (e.g., $8.90 CPC at 2.5% CVR = $356 implied CAC) can exceed your solved Max Viable CAC ceiling. That means you must use SEO, outbound, or lower-CPC geos instead of generic search ads.
- **Q: Does IdeaStress include Stripe US fees and taxes?**
  A: Yes. You can toggle Stripe US (2.9% + $0.30), Stripe US + Billing (3.6% + $0.30), or Merchant of Record Paddle/Lemon Squeezy (5% + $0.50), plus an optional effective income tax reserve on positive monthly profit.

## Break-Even Calculator (with US Stripe & MoR Fees)
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/break-even-calculator/

### Exact Formula
```text
Net_Unit_Contribution = Selling_Price × (1 − Refund_Rate) − Variable_Cost − Payment_Fee
Break_Even_Units = ceil(Fixed_Monthly_Costs / Net_Unit_Contribution)
```

### Worked Example
At a $65 selling price, 2% refund rate ($63.70 net), $22 variable cost, and $2.19 Stripe US fee, net unit contribution is $39.51. Covering $4,200 in fixed monthly overhead requires ceil(4200 / 39.51) = 107 units/month ($6,955 monthly revenue).

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: How do Stripe fees affect break-even units?**
  A: Stripe's US domestic card fee of 2.9% + $0.30 reduces your contribution margin on every sale, which increases the exact number of units required to cover fixed overhead — especially on low-ticket items under $25.
- **Q: What happens when variable cost exceeds net selling price?**
  A: Unit contribution margin becomes negative, meaning every additional unit sold loses money. IdeaStress flags break-even as Unreachable instead of outputting a misleading negative number.
- **Q: Should ad spend be included in fixed overhead for break-even?**
  A: If you run a fixed monthly ad budget (e.g., $1,000/mo), include it in fixed overhead to compute true cash break-even; if you scale ad spend per order (CPA), add CPA to variable cost per unit.
- **Q: Is break-even revenue the same as profit?**
  A: No. Break-even revenue is simply the point where total revenue equals total fixed plus variable costs ($0 operating profit before taxes).

## SaaS LTV / CAC & Payback Calculator (2026 Benchmarks)
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/saas-ltv-cac-calculator/

### Exact Formula
```text
Monthly_Gross_Profit = (ARPA × Gross_Margin_Pct) − Payment_Fee
LTV = Monthly_Gross_Profit / Monthly_Churn_Rate
CAC_Payback_Months = CAC / Monthly_Gross_Profit
```

### Worked Example
For a $49/mo SaaS with 80% gross margin, Stripe Billing fee ($2.06), 5.5% monthly churn, and $180 CAC: net monthly gross profit is $37.14, LTV is $675, LTV:CAC is 3.75x (healthy > 3.0x), and CAC payback is 4.8 months.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: What is a healthy SaaS LTV:CAC ratio in 2026?**
  A: 3.0x remains the minimum healthy rule of thumb, while 2026 private SaaS medians sit around 4.1x with an 80% software gross margin and 16-month CAC payback period (Benchmarkit / SubscriptionPlaybook 2026).
- **Q: What is average monthly churn for low-priced SaaS?**
  A: According to ChartMogul's November 2026 benchmarks, median monthly customer churn is 6.2% for SaaS with ARPA under $25, compared to 2.6% for SaaS above $1,000 ARPA.
- **Q: Why must LTV be gross-margin adjusted?**
  A: Using raw revenue instead of gross profit overstates customer value, especially for AI-heavy SaaS products where LLM token COGS compress gross margin well below 80%.
- **Q: Can LTV be calculated if monthly churn is 0%?**
  A: No. Dividing by zero produces infinity; with zero observed churn on a small early cohort, treat LTV as unvalidated until at least 3–6 months of retention data exist.

## E-Commerce Profit Margin & Break-Even ROAS Calculator
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/ecommerce-roas-calculator/

### Exact Formula
```text
Pre_Ad_Margin = AOV − COGS − Shipping − Payment_Fee
Break_Even_ROAS = AOV / Pre_Ad_Margin
First_Order_Net_Profit = Pre_Ad_Margin − Ad_CPA
```

### Worked Example
On a $68 AOV order with $19 COGS, $7 shipping, and $2.27 Stripe/Shopify fee, pre-ad margin is $39.73 (58.4%). Break-Even ROAS is 68 / 39.73 = 1.71x. At a $34 paid ad CPA, you keep $5.73 first-order net profit.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: What is Break-Even ROAS in e-commerce?**
  A: Break-Even ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) is the minimum ad revenue multiple required so first-order gross profit exactly covers your ad spend. Any ROAS below this floor loses money on every new customer.
- **Q: What is the average e-commerce CAC in 2026?**
  A: First Page Sage benchmarks place blended e-commerce CAC between $53 and $91 across 13 verticals, which is why low-AOV stores (<$40) struggle on paid ads without high repeat purchase rates.
- **Q: What is a realistic Shopify conversion rate in 2026?**
  A: Littledata's late-2026 Shopify dataset reports a 1.4% median store conversion rate, with the top 20% exceeding 2.7% and top 10% exceeding 3.7%.
- **Q: How do e-commerce gross margins vary by category?**
  A: Hycos 2026 benchmarks show 60%–80% for Beauty & Skincare, 55%–70% for Health & Supplements, 45%–65% for Fashion & Apparel, and 15%–30% for Consumer Electronics.

## Startup Runway & Burn Stress-Tester
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/startup-runway-calculator/

### Exact Formula
```text
Monthly_Net_Burn(m) = Monthly_Expenses − Monthly_Revenue(m)
Runway = First month m where Cash(m) < 0
```

### Worked Example
With $45,000 cash, $3,500 monthly revenue growing 10%/mo, and $8,500 monthly burn, base runway is ~14 months; under a −30% revenue and +20% expense shock, runway compresses sharply to ~6 months.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: Why stress-test runway with a −30% revenue and +20% cost shock?**
  A: Early startup revenue is lumpy and infrastructure, ad spend, or contractor costs routinely overrun. Planning solely on base-case runway leaves zero buffer when a channel slows down.
- **Q: What is the difference between gross burn and net burn?**
  A: Gross burn is total monthly cash outflow (expenses). Net burn is expenses minus monthly revenue collected. Runway is governed by net burn.
- **Q: How many months of runway should a bootstrapped founder keep?**
  A: Keep at least 6–12 months of shock-tested runway before committing to fixed recurring expenses like full-time hires or annual office leases.
- **Q: Does revenue growth automatically extend runway?**
  A: Only if unit contribution margin is positive and customer acquisition spend does not scale faster than collected cash.

## AI Wrapper Token Cost & Whale Bankruptcy Calculator
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/ai-token-margin-calculator/

### Exact Formula
```text
Cost_Per_Request = (Input_Tokens / 1e6) × In_Rate + (Output_Tokens / 1e6) × Out_Rate
Monthly_AI_COGS = Cost_Per_Request × Daily_Requests × 30
Whale_Daily_Limit = floor((Price − Stripe_Fee − Infra) / (Cost_Per_Request × 30))
```

### Worked Example
On a $29/mo plan using a Mid/Balanced model ($1.25 in / $5.00 out per 1M tokens) at 3,000 input + 900 output tokens ($0.00825/req) and 25 requests/day, monthly AI COGS is $6.19 plus $1.14 Stripe fee and $1 infra = $8.33 variable cost (71.3% margin). Any whale user exceeding 108 requests/day turns unprofitable.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: Why do AI SaaS products have lower gross margins than traditional SaaS?**
  A: Traditional private SaaS averages ~80% gross margin (Benchmarkit 2026), whereas AI apps incur recurring per-token inference COGS on every user prompt, often compressing margins to 40%–65%.
- **Q: What is the Whale Bankruptcy Limit?**
  A: It is the exact number of daily requests at which a heavy power user on a flat-rate 'unlimited' subscription costs more in LLM API fees than their entire monthly payment.
- **Q: How can I protect margins on an AI wrapper?**
  A: Route routine prompts to budget/mini models, enforce hard max_tokens caps, cache repeated context, and gate frontier reasoning or video generation behind credit packs or add-on tiers.
- **Q: Can IdeaStress scan my actual repository for token cost risks?**
  A: Yes. Run `ideastress scan-repo ./my-app --price 29` via CLI or MCP to statically detect OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Replicate SDK calls inside loops and missing max_tokens caps.

## 5-Country Geo-Arbitrage CPC & CAC Scanner (US / UK / DE / SG / MY)
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/geo-arbitrage-cpc-scanner/

### Exact Formula
```text
Localized_Implied_CAC = Country_CPC / Conversion_Rate
Arbitrage_Headroom = Localized_Max_Viable_CAC / Localized_Implied_CAC
```

### Worked Example
When US Google Ads CPC is $8.90 (implied CAC $356 at 2.5% CVR) and your US ceiling is $200, US paid search fails (0.56x headroom). In Malaysia, localized CPC (~$2.31) yields ~$92 implied CAC against a $110 localized ceiling (1.19x headroom — CHANNEL_VIABLE).

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: What is Geo-Arbitrage in SaaS and indie hacking?**
  A: It is launching into non-US or non-English markets where Google Ads CPC and competition are 2x–4x lower than the US while local willingness to pay still supports profitable unit economics.
- **Q: Why is US Google Ads CPC so high in 2026?**
  A: Publicly tracked indie SaaS products roughly tripled between 2020 and 2026 and CAC rose ~60% over five years, driving US high-intent B2B keywords to $6–$15+ per click.
- **Q: Does IdeaStress support live multi-country CPC lookups?**
  A: Yes. With a DataForSEO key in `.env`, `ideastress geo-scan` queries live Google Ads search volume and CPC by country `location_code` and caches results for 30 days in SQLite.
- **Q: Should I adjust pricing when entering lower-CPC countries?**
  A: Yes. Our scanner automatically scales your localized max viable CAC by a purchasing-power factor so you do not overestimate revenue in lower-ARPA regions.

## Quit-Your-Job MRR & US Solo Founder Take-Home Calculator
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/quit-job-mrr-calculator/

### Exact Formula
```text
Required_PreTax_Profit = (Target_Annual_Salary / 12) / (1 − Effective_Tax_Rate)
Required_Customers = ceil((Required_PreTax_Profit + Monthly_Ops) / (Price × (1 − Fee_Pct) − Fee_Flat))
```

### Worked Example
To replace a $120,000/yr net salary ($10,000/mo) with a 30% tax reserve ($14,286 pre-tax profit needed) and $1,500 monthly ops on a $49/mo Stripe US plan ($47.28 net/cust), you need 334 paying customers = $16,366 MRR. Using Stripe US saves ~$4,925/yr in fees vs a 5% + $0.50 MoR.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: How much MRR do I need to replace a $100,000 salary in the US?**
  A: After setting aside ~30% for US federal/state/self-employment taxes, payment processing fees, and modest operating costs, replacing $100k net typically requires $13,000–$15,000 in stable MRR.
- **Q: Should I use Stripe or a Merchant of Record (Paddle / Lemon Squeezy)?**
  A: Stripe US charges 2.9% + $0.30 (cheaper on fees), while Paddle/Lemon Squeezy charge 5% + $0.50 but act as the legal seller handling global VAT and US sales tax compliance for you.
- **Q: Why shouldn't I quit my job the first month I hit target MRR?**
  A: Early SaaS MRR has high churn volatility. Wait until you have held target MRR for 3+ consecutive months and banked 6–12 months of personal emergency runway.
- **Q: Is this formal US tax advice?**
  A: No. Tax reserve percentages are planning estimates only; consult a licensed CPA for LLC/S-Corp elections and quarterly estimated tax filings.

## Freemium Economics & Free-User Cost Drag Calculator
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/freemium-economics-calculator/

### Exact Formula
```text
Free_Tier_Drag = Free_Users × Monthly_Cost_Per_Free_User
Min_BreakEven_CVR = Free_Cost / (Paid_Unit_Contribution + Free_Cost)
```

### Worked Example
With 10,000 MAU, 2% conversion (200 paid @ $29 = $5,800 rev), $0.35/mo free-user cost ($3,430 drag), and $4 paid COGS + Stripe fees ($1,028), net monthly gross profit is only $1,342 (23.1% blended margin). At $0.60/free user, the business bleeds cash every month.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: When does a Freemium model fail for AI SaaS?**
  A: Freemium fails whenever free users consume recurring LLM tokens or GPU compute without driving viral word-of-mouth — even $0.50/mo per free user destroys margins at a typical 1.5%–2% conversion rate.
- **Q: What is a realistic free-to-paid conversion rate?**
  A: Self-serve B2B/prosumer freemium products typically convert 1%–5% of free signups; assuming >8% without strong usage gates is usually overly optimistic.
- **Q: How do I fix a bleeding freemium tier?**
  A: Replace unlimited free access with a one-time free credit allowance (e.g., 10 lifetime credits), a 7–14 day reverse trial, or strict client-side/zero-cost free tools.
- **Q: Why does Stripe fee apply only to paid users?**
  A: Payment processing fees (2.9% + $0.30) are incurred only on paid transactions, while infrastructure and AI token costs apply to both free and paid cohorts.

## Meta & TikTok Paid Social Funnel Calculator (CPM → CTR → CVR → CPA)
URL: https://waterdolphinkiller.github.io/ideastress/meta-tiktok-cpm-calculator/

### Exact Formula
```text
Effective_CPC = CPM / (1000 × CTR)
Implied_Social_CPA = Effective_CPC / Landing_Page_CVR
First_Order_Net = (AOV × Pre_Ad_Margin_Pct) − Implied_Social_CPA
```

### Worked Example
At $18 CPM and 1.2% CTR (12 clicks per 1,000 impressions), effective CPC is $1.50. At 2.2% landing-page conversion, implied CPA is $68.18. On a $68 AOV product with 60% margin ($40.80 pre-ad profit), you lose $27.38 on every first order — requiring higher CTR creative, bundles to lift AOV, or strong repeat LTV.

### Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: Why calculate paid social from CPM instead of CPC?**
  A: Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok charge by impressions (CPM). Your real CPC is entirely determined by creative thumb-stop and click-through rate (CTR).
- **Q: What is a realistic Meta Ads CTR and landing-page CVR?**
  A: Cold paid social campaigns commonly see 0.8%–1.8% link CTR and 1.4%–2.7% Shopify store conversion rate (Littledata 2026 median is 1.4%).
- **Q: Which lever improves paid social CPA fastest?**
  A: Doubling creative CTR from 0.9% to 1.8% cuts your effective CPC and CPA in half immediately without changing your product price or website.
- **Q: Can a store survive negative first-order profit on Meta Ads?**
  A: Only if you have verified 60-to-90-day repeat purchase LTV and enough working capital cash to float the payback period without running dry.
